cells.gaps: No row gives the 2016 policy a period, so it is read as open on instruments.csv, which shows no end year and no replacement; its costed implementation strategy ran 2016/17 to 2020/21 and that period is not the policy's. No report against the 2016 policy's targets has been found, and no finance fact falls inside the 36 months (TZA-021 is from 2016). The National ICT Policy 2023 review (TZA-010 to TZA-016) is validated with no adoption on record, so it places nothing.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2016: adopted in May 2016, text public on the ministry's site, no stated end, still cited as the policy in 2025. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no results report against it has been found; adopted more than ten years before the as-at, so flagged dated.
